title: The Chairs Are Back. The Coffee Is On. ☕
why_read: This is a community/narrative blog post announcing the return of a fictional café newsletter series, with no technical content at all.
analysis: The post is a narrative, almost literary announcement about a recurring fictional 'café' setting used in a series called 'AI, Ego & the 36 Stratagems,' now relaunching as a new newsletter called 'The Third Cup.' There is no actual engineering, tooling, or technical substance described anywhere in the excerpt. It reads as creative writing or community-building content rather than anything a software engineer would learn from. Not relevant for a technical digest beyond perhaps community culture interest.
